capabilities: Read any note on a pan-and-zoom board with pinch, drag, wheel and double-tap gestures
Render a note as a single recompiled 1280px-wide whiteboard page
Adjust Obsidian's reading view line width and zoom via CSS
Open images and diagrams in a zoomable full-resolution viewer
Rewrite Mermaid label layout so long labels wrap and boxes follow the text
disambiguation: Whiteboard mode is one wide page for reading a note, not a card-and-connector canvas.
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Documentation is bilingual Chinese/English, and the plugin makes no network requests or telemetry.
intentEvidence: The reading view is Obsidian's own page, so the plugin does not take it over
problem: Obsidian's reading view cannot be pinch-zoomed on mobile, and wide tables, diagrams and screenshots get squeezed into the theme's line width.
summary: Pan-and-zoom reader for notes: pinch-to-zoom mobile reading, a wide whiteboard page mode, and a zoomable image and diagram viewer.
